messages:
marco: spinning up eu4 GPU cluster today. before we handover, need a short security smoke: IAM roles, secrets sync, CMEK/KMS/HSM bindings, nodepool identities, and network egress checks. who can run 5–10m quick checks?
anya: I can take this and post results here. will run the checklist and surface blockers.
deploy-bot: cluster eu4-gpu-01 created (k8s v1.26). nodepool gpu-a100-1 (taint: nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule) provisioned.
anya: 1) Service accounts: verify SA iam bindings for infra components. quick command I use: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --flatten=bindings --filter="bindings.members:serviceAccount:infra-sa@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --format=json`
samir: 2) KMS/CMEK: confirm key ring location matches eu4 and key has protectionLevel=HSM if using HSM. sample: `gcloud kms keys describe $KEY --keyring=$RING --location=eu4 --format=json` and check `purpose` + `primary.protectionLevel`.
leah: 3) Secrets sync: validate Vault -> k8s sync. quick smoke: `kubectl -n infra get secret kms-proxy -o yaml | yq .data` and ensure expected keys present. also verify secret annotation `vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject` if using agent injector.
anya: 4) RBAC: run brief audit for overly broad bindings: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.kind=="ServiceAccount") | {name: .metadata.name, subjects: .subjects}'` — look for system:master equivalents.
marco: 5) Network: ensure no wide-open egress from GPU nodepool subnets (no 0.0.0.0/0 NAT shortcuts), ensure private cluster + master authorized networks as expected. `gcloud compute routes list --filter="network:eu4-vpc"` and `gcloud compute routers nats describe nat-eu4 --region=eu4`
devops: cost note: CMEK + HSM keys add per-operation charges; also A100 regional bandwidth & GPUs will bump month spend. flag finance for capacity commit consideration.
anya: quick results: SA bindings mostly ok but found `redwood-kms-proxy-sa@proj` missing `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key ring. patched with: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/.../locations/eu4/keyRings/rw-keyring/cryptoKeys/rw-key --member=serviceAccount:redwood-kms-proxy-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
samir: KMS smoke: created ephemeral key with `protectionLevel=HSM`, encrypted a small payload and decrypted it. CloudAudit log shows ENCRYPT/DECRYPT entries: `ENCRYPT, resourceName=projects/.../cryptoKeys/rw-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1` — looks good.
leah: secrets-sync smoke: initial pod `gpu-provisioner` failed to mount token due to missing projected serviceAccountToken in deployment. added `serviceAccount: redwood-kms-proxy-sa` and `serviceAccountTokenProjection` fix; re-deployed, secret now mounts and app reads keys.
anya: RBAC follow-ups: created ticket INFRA-2248 to narrow a handful of dev team clusterrolebindings that reference cluster-admin indirectly. recommend schedule least-privilege pass post-handoff.
marco: network check: nat-eu4 uses Cloud NAT with restricted destinations. egress rules reviewed; no public 0.0.0.0/0 source-routes from nodepools. noted we need to add a denylist for telemetry exfil endpoints next sprint.
devops: added finance stub: TICKET-FIN-331 for projected monthly cost delta (GPUs + CMEK ops).
marco: next steps: 1) copy these notes into infra runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/eu4-security-smoke 2) handover to oncall for tomorrow 09:00 UTC 3) follow-up RBAC least-privilege audit (INFRA-2248). @oncall please ack :eyes:  
oncall: acked, will take 09:00 UTC handover and validate runbook. please add any additional commands you used.
marco: thanks all — summary: one immediate IAM binding patched, secrets mount fix applied, CMEK/HSM validated, no network wide-open issues, finance ticket opened. I'll draft a short checklist to land in the runbook and assign owners for the RBAC cleanup.
